messages:
sarah: getting multiple reports that pages didn't hit oncall for the last ~10m. @incident-bot shows events but no external deliveries. anyops?
incident-bot: automated note: 12 alerts suppressed by rule 'suppress-duplicates' between 1768129800 and 1768129950. See /alerts/176812/summary
mike: I can confirm. pagerbridge logs show a bunch of 5xx from /outbound/route -> 502 gateway errors to notify-proxy.
ashley: I'm oncall — I didn't receive any pages or SMS. I did get the slack channel notifications though.
jordan: looking at the webhook proxy metrics: sudden spike in 502 and 503s around 1768129880. downstream twilio responses show "502 Bad Gateway" for our /v1/send call.
sarah: are we sure this is an upstream (twilio) outage vs our signing/rotation? last rotation happened ~2h ago.
mike: good point. checking signature verification errors in the proxy now.
ops-bot: fetch logs cluster=notify-proxy env=prod timeframe=1768129800..1768130200
ops-bot: returning 120 log lines (truncated)
mike: seeing a pattern: proxy returns 401/403 then upstream 502 cascade. TLS handshakes look fine. header X-Signature missing on a subset of retries.
jordan: oh. the deploy that rotated signing key accidentally changed header name from `X-Signature` to `X-Service-Signature` for retry paths. that would cause our outbound gateway to reject and sometimes trigger fallback that hits an invalid route -> 502.
ashley: so incident-bot suppressed due to duplicate-suppress because retries lost signature and got rejected -> no page delivered. we should remove suppression temporarily and manual page affected teams.
sarah: agreed. start manual paging escalations for pagerflow-critical and engage customers who have active incidents. I'll take customer comms.
mike: rolling hotfix to revert header name. patch: `notify-proxy: restore header X-Signature for retry path` -> will deploy in ~2m.
jordan: also reconfiguring incident-bot suppression window to 30s from 5m for now, to avoid swallowing retries.
incident-bot: rule update requested by jordan: duplicate suppression window set to 30s (was 5m) — pending approval.
ashley: approving. go ahead. :thumbsup:
mike: deployed hotfix to canary, logs now show `X-Signature` present on retry flows and downstream 200s from twilio for the test route. promoting to prod.
ops-bot: deploy prod notify-proxy v1.2.9 promoted by mike at 1768130305
pagerbridge-bot: delivery backlog drained; 42 pending pages retried and 40 succeeded, 2 failed (carrier errors).
sarah: manual escalation done for two customer-facing incidents — customers notified they may have missed real-time pages; support is on the case.
jordan: root cause tentative: deploy regression changed outbound header name on retry path -> signature mismatch -> outbound gateway rejects -> retry logic triggered alternate path causing 502 cascade -> incident-bot duplicate-suppress swallowed retries.
mike: immediate mitigations: reverted header change, tightened suppression window, retried backlog, manual pages for impacted customers.
ashley: any customer impact metrics? how many missed/late pages?
sarah: initial tally: ~42 internal oncalls retried successfully; 2 customer escalations missed initial page and were contacted within 18m. low user-visible impact but not acceptable.
jordan: opening follow-up: TRACK-9456 to add e2e test for header presence on retry flows and a unit test to prevent header-name drift, owner: jordan.
mike: also adding synthetic paging integration monitor that checks delivery and suppression interactions every 5m.
incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1768129999 by sarah. severity: P2. postmortem owner assigned: jordan.
sarah: thanks team. can we get a quick retro in #eng-oncall tomorrow? want to capture why the signing rotation deploy missed this path and why suppression window was so aggressive.
ashley: noted. I'll put a short runbook update: when rotating signing keys, validate `retry_path_headers` in notify-proxy config and run the synthetic paging check before cutover.
mike: marking thread resolved for routing — monitoring for 30m. will update when green.
ops-bot: synth check OK at 1768131200; pager delivery success 100% over last 10m.
sarah: thanks — closing customer comms slate. please link any logs or follow-ups to INC-2026-1768129999 and TRACK-9456.
jordan: I'll draft the postmortem and include remediation and owner timelines.
ashley: :white_check_mark: all good from oncall side.
mike: resolved, moving to monitoring.
incident-bot: incident INC-2026-1768129999 status -> resolved at 1768131399
sarah: great work team, we'll review tomorrow in retro.
